Own the roadmap of the registration platform behind one of the world’s largest top-level domains, from EPP to data analytics.

Product Owner – Registration Services

Our client is a European not-for-profit organisation, human-sized and firmly technology-driven, responsible for managing and operating one of the world’s largest country-code top-level domains in the public interest.

What makes it stand out? It delivers secure, resilient and accessible registration services to millions of users across Europe, through a network of accredited registrars.

The organisation is modernising its core registration platform and shaping the next generation of services supporting the registration and management of domain names.

To drive this, it is looking for a Product Owner to define the vision, roadmap and priorities across these mission-critical activities: core registration platform, EPP, registration APIs, domain-name lifecycle, registry-to-registrar integrations, data analytics and platform modernisation.

 

The job

• Based in Diegem and working within the Technology Department, you operate at the intersection of Business Operations, Architecture and Service Design, Engineering, Service Delivery, Compliance and Security.
• Translate strategic, operational, regulatory and stakeholder needs into clear product direction and deliverable priorities, balancing immediate service improvements with long-term modernisation, resilience, security and technological sovereignty.Role
• Define and maintain the product vision, strategy and roadmap for the assigned Registration Services areas: core registration platform, EPP, registration APIs, RDAP, domain-name lifecycle and data analytics capabilities.
• Own, structure and prioritise the backlog, making transparent trade-offs between business value, urgency, risk, delivery capacity, dependencies and long-term sustainability.
• Work closely with Business Owners and with the engineering, architecture, service delivery, compliance and security teams to ensure requirements are understood, feasible and aligned.
• Give clear product direction to the Business Analysts, validate functional requirements and acceptance criteria, and own functional acceptance through to go/no-go release decisions.
• Ensure compliance with GDPR, NIS2, AI regulations and internal governance frameworks, and monitor developments within ICANN, IETF, CENTR and the wider domain-name ecosystem.
Profile
• University degree in computer science, engineering, business, information systems or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
• At least seven years in technology-driven products or services, including substantial experience as a Product Owner or Product Manager. Familiarity with the domain-name ecosystem, EPP, WHOIS or RDAP and DNS provisioning is a strong asset, as is a background in telecommunications or another regulated service industry.
• Excellent written and spoken English; knowledge of other European languages is an asset.

We are looking for an Expert Electrical Engineer for a modern manufacturing company in Hooglede – someone who enjoys getting stuck in and wants to take their technical knowledge to the next level. You will be in charge of your own section within the machinery department and will become the go-to specialist that everyone turns to when things get a bit more technically challenging.

What’s on your to-do list?

• You will be the main technical point of contact for your department.
• Electrical or mechanical fault? You’ll pinpoint the problem and find a solution!
• You’ll calibrate and optimise machinery to ensure production runs smoothly.
• You’ll work with PLC systems, motors, sensors and variable speed drives.
• You read electrical diagrams and delve into technical drawings.
• You also tackle hydraulic and pneumatic problems.
• You monitor maintenance and scheduled interventions and keep the technical documentation up to date.
You’re our ideal candidate if…

• You have a bachelor’s degree in electromechanics, with a focus on electrical engineering, or equivalent experience.
• You combine technical insight with a genuine ‘can-do’ attitude.
• You can analyse and resolve faults independently.
• You work accurately and always put safety first.
• You work well both independently and as part of a team.
• You have a good command of Dutch and/or English.
Ready to put your technical skills into practice? Send us a message and find out if this job could be your next step!

Are you the passionate technician we're looking for to strengthen our team? Agristo, a market leader in the food industry, is looking for a preventive maintenance technician who is passionate about ensuring the reliability and efficiency of our machines and installations. As a technician, you play a crucial role in ensuring maximum uptime for our machinery.Are you up to the challenge?Then this job at Agristo, at our Wielsbeke site, is for you!What will you be doing at Agristo?As a maintenance technician, you're passionate about ensuring the reliability and efficiency of our machines and installations. Your objective? To ensure smooth operation and minimise downtime. 
• Set an example by following the prescribed guidelines and procedures for a (food) safe, environmentally friendly and orderly working environment. 
• As a technician, you recognise potential problems before they cause breakdowns. You report these observations accurately, enabling us to act proactively and minimise unscheduled downtime. 
• You carry out planned maintenance tasks, such as inspections, lubrications, adjustments and replacements. 
• You will work closely with our operational teams and your technical colleagues to optimise the maintenance plan. 
• You will provide the necessary support and follow-up to external collaborators to ensure that their contribution is effective and efficient. In addition, you will mentor technical trainees and new employees to help them progress in their role. 
• You will keep accurate records of maintenance work carried out, using the maintenance software (Ultimo).
 
• You have technical training or equivalent experience. 
• You have several years' experience as a technician and a passion for technology. 
• You have knowledge of mechanical, electrical, hydraulic and pneumatic systems. 
• You have a proactive attitude. 
• You have logical thinking and good problem-solving skills, enabling you to work independently. 
• You are a team player who contributes to smooth communication and collective success. 
• You speak Dutch, French or English and are prepared to understand colleagues who speak other languages. 
• You are prepared to work in a 2-shift system.

Are you a passionate machine learning engineer with expertise in generative AI? Join our Machine Learning Enablers team at Proximus Ada, where you’ll play a key role in advancing and scaling generative AI capabilities across teams. You will leverage your expertise in architectures such as retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and agent-based systems to develop and maintain reusable components and templates that enable data scientists to deliver impactful solutions. 

In this role, you will collaborate closely with data scientists in delivery teams and engineers from our Cloud and DevSecOps teams to implement best practices and ensure technical excellence across multiple projects. Using frameworks such as LangChain and LangGraph and our Azure-first stack, you will maintain and expand a shared repository of reusable generative AI assets that enable scalable, reliable solutions. 

Your innovative mindset will help identify emerging techniques and translate them into practical building blocks that deliver business value, keeping our teams aligned with the latest advances. Your work will support the day-to-day needs of our data scientists through the practical maintenance, hands-on support, and enhancement of shared assets, while also driving innovation in our generative AI initiatives. 

Responsibilities 

Develop and Maintain our Generative AI Repository 

• Manage and expand our shared repository of reusable Generative AI components and templates, ensuring it is robust, up-to-date, well-documented, and easy to adopt across use cases. 
• Support onboarding and adoption: help teams use the repository effectively, keep alignment with the main branch, and facilitate clean integration of shared changes. 
• Collaborate with data scientists to identify new components to build, provide technical support, and promote best practices in using the repository. 
• Drive key upgrades and migrations of core libraries and templates (e.g., LangChain/LangGraph) with minimal disruption to delivery teams. 
Enable Agent-Based and Generative AI Solutions 

• Guide delivery teams on architectures such as retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and agent-based systems, providing hands-on technical support and troubleshooting when needed. 
• Research and prototype emerging techniques, frameworks, and Azure services; translate validated approaches into reusable building blocks for delivery teams. 
Collaborate and Drive Technical Excellence 

• Define and promote software engineering best practices for Generative AI solutions (testing, code quality, style, automation) and enforce them through PR reviews and shared standards. 
• Collaborate with Cloud, DevSecOps, enterprise architecture, and vendors to ensure solutions and technologies align with our stack and constraints.
• Stay current with advances in Generative AI and communicate relevant learnings and recommendations to the organization. 
 

Profile

Education 

• Master’s degree in Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field. 
• A Ph.D. is a plus, especially with research in Generative AI or agent-based systems. 
Professional Experience 

• Minimum of 2+ years of relevant experience in a business environment in AI/ML engineering or software engineering.
• Proven experience working with generative AI models and LLMs in real-world projects. 
• Demonstrated ability to build reusable components and templates, and transition proof-of-concepts into production-ready assets. 
• Experience collaborating with delivery teams and stakeholders, providing technical guidance and support. 
Technical Skills 

• Strong coding skills in Python, with solid software engineering best practices (testing, code quality, documentation, maintainable design). 
• Proficiency with version control (Git) and modern development workflows, including CI/CD pipelines. 
• Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure and relevant Azure Data & AI services. 
• Experience with Generative AI frameworks such as LangChain; familiarity with LangGraph is a plus. 
• Experience implementing MLOps best practices (e.g., experiment tracking with MLflow). 
• Familiarity with monitoring and evaluation practices for Generative AI applications. 
Soft Skills 

• Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with attention to detail.
• Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts, provide actionable guidance, and produce high-quality documentation. 
• Collaboration and enablement mindset: comfortable supporting and mentoring others through code reviews and hands-on troubleshooting. 
• Ownership and autonomy: able to prioritize effectively and drive work to completion in a transversal context. 
• Curiosity and innovation mindset: proactive in exploring new techniques and translating them into practical improvements. 
Languages 

• Fluent in English and preferably also French and/or Dutch.

Are you passionate about global brands and eager to support their development across international markets? Join our team as Global Brand Packaging Specialist, where your organizational skills and project management expertise will be key to driving our brands’ success internationally.

As a Group Food Safety & Quality Assurance (FSQA) Audit & Certification Assistant, you will provide administrative, analytical, and reporting support for food safety audits and certification programs across our international production sites.
 
 

• Coordinate food safety, sustainability, religious, ethical, and customer-specific certification schemes across the Group. 

• Monitor certification statuses, audit schedules, renewal timelines, and maintain accurate compliance records and databases. 

• Support the planning, administration, documentation, and follow-up of internal and external audits across production sites. 

• Develop and maintain KPI dashboards, reporting tools, and perform trend analyses to support data-driven decision-making. 

• Track audit findings and corrective actions, ensuring timely follow-up and closure. 

• Provide administrative and analytical support for continuous improvement projects, annual program reviews, and FSQA initiatives. 

To be able to achieve the above and be successful in this role we believe you need to have:
 
 

• A Bachelor's degree in a food-related or data-analytical field. 

• Experience in an administrative or support role within a technical, quality, or food industry environment. 

• Strong reporting and data management skills, with advanced knowledge of MS Office applications. 

• Experience with databases, KPI reporting, dashboards, and data visualization tools; knowledge of auditing and certification schemes is a strong asset. 

• Professional proficiency in English, knowledge of Dutch and/or French is a plus. 

• A detail-oriented, analytical, and structured mindset, combined with flexibility, independence, and a positive attitude.

As an Inventory Planner Natural Foods, you play a key role in ensuring the right stock is available at the right time. By working closely with production, suppliers, and sales, you help achieve an optimal balance between availability and costs. With your proactive approach, you contribute to a smooth supply chain and sustainable results.
 

Job description
 
 

• Managing and creating purchase orders for production plants, co‑manufacturers, and suppliers based on aligned planning with the demand planning teams. 

• Monitoring and analysing inventory levels to ensure optimal availability and service levels. 

• Proactively communicating about supply and expiry risks and contributing to the implementation of robust inventory management processes and best practices. 

• Aligning with internal production and supply chain teams to follow up on production plans and to identify and mitigate potential supply risks in a timely manner. 

• Monitoring production and transportation flows and ensuring accurate and up‑to‑date data in SAP. 

• Continuously improving and further automating the replenishment process, including optimisation of planning parameters. 

Profile
 

To be able to achieve the above and be successful in this role we believe you need to have:
 
 

• You hold a bachelor’s degree in a business‑related field. 

• You have at least one to two years of experience in supply chain planning, preferably in an FMCG or retail environment, and are familiar with working in a logistics‑ or transport‑oriented customer service setting; knowledge of SAP is a plus. 

• You have strong verbal and written communication skills in English and collaborate smoothly with various internal departments. 

• You work independently and proactively, with a strong attention to detail and a high level of accuracy. 

• You are able to set priorities and work efficiently in a fast‑paced, dynamic environment.

Responsibilities

• Evaluate backend and endpoint infrastructure to define upgrades, changes, and expansion proposals.
• Conduct feasibility studies and evaluate hardware and software solutions to meet organizational needs.
• Develop technical designs in alignment with specific architectural requirements and implement system improvements.
• Provide high-level support and maintenance for the IT infrastructure following ITIL methodologies.
• Deliver technical advice and information to internal and external stakeholders regarding the technology stack.
• Maintain technical documentation and actively share expertise within the engineering team.

Requirements

• You possess 8+ years of experience in system engineering within large-scale environments of at least 100,000 endpoints.
• You have expert knowledge of Intune, including MDM, MAM, BYOD, Enterprise Mobility + Security, and Conditional Access Policies.
• You bring advanced expertise in System Center Configuration Manager (SCCM), focusing on distribution groups, task sequences, and software management.
• You have in-depth experience with Active Directory, LDAP, GPO, and domain management.
• You possess deep expertise in infrastructure stacks for Windows, MacOS, Linux, Android, and iOS.
• You have 5+ years of experience with PowerShell and VBScript for infrastructure automation.
• You bring broad knowledge of Azure, including license assignment and dynamic groups, alongside Office 365 and Windows Defender.
• You possess a solid understanding of networking protocols such as TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, and VLAN.
• You’re able to interact effectively with diverse technical and business stakeholders.
• You are fluent in Dutch or French with a very good level of English.
Nice to Haves

• Certifications in MCSA, MCSE, or MCSD.
• Experience with ServiceNow or PM² methodology.
• Knowledge of PatchMyPC or 3rd party MDM solutions like Knox or KAI.

FLYINGGROUP, one of Europe’s leading business jet operators, has an open position for a Flight Care Agent at the main office in Antwerp.

The Flight Care Agent is a member of the Operational Control Centre Team. The main OCC activities are the planning and preparation of FLYINGGROUP’s flights. The OCC supports our global operations and our business is rapidly growing. We are expanding our worldwide activity and are looking for a Flight Care Agent.

Your goal

You will be joining our OCC Flight Care Department which always strives to make the most informed decisions and provide top-quality service to our clients, making our company stand out from the rest.

Your duties and responsibilities

The planning and preparation of all FLYINGGROUP’s flights, including VIP catering arrangements, Customer transportation, keeping PAX details and formalities up to date and performing detailed feasibility checks, taking appropriate action to tackle any irregularity. You provide good support to the Senior Flight Care Agent in completing other tasks as assigned.

Your profile

• The Flight Care Agent is highly Customer minded and pays full attention to the particulars of each Customer.
• Good communication skills, meaning an excellent (spoken and written) knowledge of Dutch and English and good knowledge of French.
• You are well organized, stress-resistant, and able to multitask while maintaining a calm composure and working with continuously changing flight schedules.

• You have good computer knowledge: Word, Excel.
• Experience in aviation is a must, experience in business aviation is a plus
• Have a good base of aviation terminology and IATA and ICAO codes.
• You are flexible, willing to work in shifts and during weekends.
• Local resident is preferable.
Offer

We offer a full-time position with a salary matching your qualifications. The work schedule is flexible in shifts and will include weekend shifts. Training "in-house".

Take the lead in operations at Skechers and guide your teams toward excellence in a fully automated and fast-growing environment!

Skechers USA is a global leader in lifestyle and performance footwear, generating $9 billion in annual revenue. The company designs, develops, and markets over 3,000 styles for men, women, and children.

Why join Skechers?

• A fast-growing international company
• A warm, dynamic, and tech-forward work environment
• A culture that embraces diversity and inclusion
• A competitive salary package
• The extra perk? An on-site gym with a personal coach
To strengthen its operational team, our client Skechers is currently looking for an Operations Manager for its site in Herstal.

 

 

Jobomschrijving

As an Operations Manager at Skechers, you report directly to the Director of Operations and independently manage several departments.

Your key responsibilities include:

• Planning, organizing, and supervising daily operations to meet short- and long-term goals, while ensuring budget, deadlines, and safety standards are met in an automated environment.
• Promoting and maintaining a strong safety culture.
• Developing strategic business plans for the short, medium, and long term for your departments.
• Taking necessary actions to achieve performance objectives by defining and monitoring team KPIs, while effectively managing operational costs.
• Leading, coaching, evaluating, and developing your teams (approx. 150 people) in collaboration with Team Leaders and Leads. Communication is central to your role—both with your teams and social partners.
• Managing and optimizing automated processes with a continuous improvement mindset.
This role requires adaptability, versatility, and a proactive approach to overcoming daily challenges and driving operational excellence.

Education and technical skills:

• Minimum 3 years of proven experience in a similar role within an automated/production environment.
• Proficiency in WMS, WCS, and AS400 systems.
• Solid knowledge of Microsoft Office tools (Excel, Word, Outlook).
• Strong working knowledge of English.
Your personality and soft skills:

• Leadership – You are a driver of change and adapt easily to a constantly evolving environment.
• Communication – You adjust your communication to suit your audience and actively listen.
• Customer & results orientation – You go the extra mile to ensure customer satisfaction.
• Stress management – You remain positive and composed when facing day-to-day challenges.
• Conflict resolution & negotiation – You are assertive and diplomatic when managing tensions.
• Attention to detail – You are uncompromising when it comes to safety and adherence to procedures and workplace rules.

Datashift, a rapidly expanding team dedicated to providing data-driven solutions for business challenges, is seeking a talented Analytics Engineer to join us.

 
Your responsibilities 
In this role, you will play a crucial part in translating client needs into sustainable data solutions, encompassing ETL processes, Infrastructure as Code, interfaces, and pipelines.

• Designing data solutions, balancing cost and maintainability.
• Collaborating with Data Scientists, BI specialists, and Business Consultants to deliver value.
• Staying abreast of the latest developments in data technology and actively sharing knowledge with colleagues.
• Monitoring the quality and stability of data solutions.
• Mentoring and coaching other Analyticals Engineer. 
Your qualifications
 

Do you have 4 to 6 years of experience, including at least 2 years in a cloud environment? Do you possess a passion for approaching projects from an end-to-end data perspective? We are delighted to receive your personal application and we’ll contact you for an interview and a (virtual) cup of coffee.

 

• You can adeptly apply diverse data modeling styles and collaborate with our customers to develop the optimal data model for their needs.
• You grasp data structures & formats and are familiar with popular (cloud) data warehouses.
• You navigate DBT with expertise, effortlessly crafting a new project, playing with all the DBT-blocks to build a castle from the ground up.
• Deep knowledge of SQL;
• You have a proven track record of effortlessly incorporating DevOps best practices such as CI/CD, IaC, and unit testing. CI/CD, which may sound like a secret code, is a realm you navigate with ease. You not only grasp its steps but can also articulate why it's indispensable for any data project. Moreover, you possess the skills to autonomously set it up.
• You approach challenges with an analytical and solution-oriented mindset, and you're well-acquainted with agile methodologies and collaborative teamwork.
• Experience with Docker and PySpark is a plus;
• Experience with dataframe API’s in Python (Panda’s, Polars, ...);
• Fluent in Dutch and/or French and English.

• You contribute to the integration of data from commercial & support fonctions systems such as ERP, CRM, marketingplatformen, HR, and other operational applications.

We are looking for an experienced Executive Assistant to provide high-level support to the Director General. This is a key position requiring exceptional organisational skills, professionalism, discretion, and the ability to operate confidently in a fast-paced international environment.

Client Details

Our client is a well-established European association based in Brussels, representing and supporting members across Europe. Operating in an international and multicultural environment, the organisation plays a key role in fostering collaboration, advocacy, and knowledge sharing within its sector.

Description

• Act as the trusted right hand and strategic support to the Director General
• Manage a complex agenda, shifting priorities, and high-level executive commitments
• Coordinate international travel, itineraries, and meeting preparations
• Monitor and manage the Director General's inbox, correspondence, and follow-ups
• Prepare presentations, briefing documents, reports, and executive materials
• Ensure action points are tracked and deadlines are met across multiple projects
• Organise and coordinate Board Meetings, General Assemblies, and leadership meetings

• Review expenses, approvals, and administrative processes
• Act as a key point of contact on behalf of the Director General when required
• Support the smooth functioning of the executive office and provide back-up within the administrative team
• Anticipate needs, solve problems proactively, and ensure nothing falls through the cracks
 

• 15 to 20 years of experience in a similar Executive Assistant role
• Previous experience supporting C-level or Executive-level leadership
• Experience within an international organisation, association, federation, or EU environment is highly desirable
• Outstanding written and verbal communication skills in English
• Excellent command of Microsoft Office (Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Outlook)
• Strong organisational and prioritisation skills
• Proactive, resourceful, and solution-oriented mindset
• Highly professional, trustworthy, and discreet
• Eager to learn and continuously improve
